action.text: Task: Add regression tests for port access (no port, empty, 0, 65535, 65536, negative, noninteger, non-ASCII digits) for both urlsplit and urlparse with text and byte URLs. Assert exception class, args, message for invalid ports; assert concrete results for valid boundary cases. Also add documentation with executable examples. Files: Lib/test/test_urlparse.py (800 lines), Doc/library/urllib.parse.rst (39 lines). Implementation: Lib/urllib/parse.py - port property (lines 177-185): checks port.isdigit() and port.isascii(), raises ValueError with specific messages for non-numeric or out-of-range.
